```lean
intro m n hx h'x
have h1 : 0 < 1 := @lt_top K _ (le_zero_iff_neg.mpr (neg_pos.mpr h'x))
have h2 : 0 < x ∨ x = 0 := le_zero_iff_neg.mp hx
cases h2 with h2 h2'
· have h3 : 0 < x := h2
  let s : ℕ → ℕ := λ i, i
  let f : ℕ → K := λ i, x ^ i
  let g : ℕ → K := λ i, x ^ i / (1 - x)
  have h4 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x ^ i := pow_nonneg h3
  have h5 : 1 - x ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h1
  have h6 : ∀ i, x ^ i ≤ x ^ m / (1 - x) := by
    intro i
    have h7 : x ^ i ≤ x ^ m := pow_le_pow h3 (le_refl m) (le_refl i)
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv] at h7
    rw [mul_inv_eq_div] at h7
    exact h7
  have h8 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico m n, x ^ i ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico m n, x ^ m / (1 - x) := 
    sum_le_sum (Finset.Ico.mono m n) (λ _, h6)
  have h9 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico m n, x ^ m / (1 - x) = x ^ m / (1 - x) * Finset.card (Finset.Ico m n) :=
    sum_const (Finset.Ico m n) (x ^ m / (1 - x))
  have h10 : Finset.card (Finset.Ico m n) = n - m := Finset.Ico.card
  rw [h9, h10] at h8
  rw [mul_div_assoc] at h8
  exact h8
· have h3 : x = 0 := h2'
  have h4 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico m n, 0 ^ i = 0 := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.Ico.card, Nat.sub_self]
  have h5 : 0 ^ m / (1 - 0) = 0 := by
    simp only [pow_zero, div_zero, zero_div, one_sub_zero, zero_one]
  exact h4.trans h5
```
